messages.text: Thursday, November 19 · Canton, Michigan
Carillon bells, improv stages, and the quiet shift of autumn light
An overcast Wednesday brings mild temperatures and a steady rhythm of local performances. We look at the intersection of community storytelling and recent shifts in public health status.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 64 degrees and a low around 33 degrees.
The sun rises at 7:30 AM and sets at 5:09 PM, with the moon currently in its first-quarter phase at 67.3% illumination.
Midweek resonance and local stages

Lon Mitchell performs a carillon recital at the Lurie Ann and Robert H. Tower in Ann Arbor at 1:20 PM. Later, catch the storytelling and improv show For Real at Go Comedy Improv Theater in Ferndale at 7:30 PM.
The Girls Gear Up outreach event is scheduled for the morning of November 21.
University policy and public health concerns

The University of Michigan Faculty Senate recently passed a vote of no confidence regarding the administration's handling of police and labor negotiations. Separately, experts continue to advise on the health risks associated with kratom products as local restrictions emerge.
Looking toward the weekend
Prepare for the upcoming Girls Gear Up outreach event taking place this Friday morning.

Friday, November 20 · Canton, Michigan
Clear skies and one light-day of distance for a lonely voyager

The air remains unseasonably warm today as we clear a path toward the weekend. Our local horizon is quiet, while far beyond it, a human-made vessel reaches a staggering new milestone in the deep void.
Expect a clear, mild day with a high near 65 degrees and a low around 40 degrees.
The sun rises at 7:31 AM and sets at 5:08 PM, while the moon is currently in a waxing gibbous phase at 76.7 percent illumination.
A quiet Thursday
With no public events scheduled locally today, it is a fine afternoon to enjoy the unseasonable warmth at one of our neighborhood parks.
Local students have the Girls Gear Up outreach event tomorrow morning at 7:30 AM.
Lansing shifts as Canton leadership rises

Incoming House Speaker Ranjeev Puri of Canton will lead a Michigan Legislature featuring a growing progressive caucus in 2027. This group is expected to advocate for corporate tax increases and government ethics reforms.
Looking toward the weekend

Ann Arbor hosts the Musket musical production of West Side Story at North Quad tomorrow at 7:00 PM. For those seeking comedy, Last Call Improv offers a free show in Hamtramck on December 3 at 9:00 PM.
